data.name: Faiyaan
data.gender_notes: Faiyaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root fa'a, which means 'to split or cleave'. This name signifies victory or triumph over challenges and adversities. It is a powerful and inspiring name for a boy in Islamic culture. The name Faiyaan carries the meaning “Victorious, Triumphant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faiyaan usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, triumphant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May Allah grant you the strength and wisdom to overcome all obstacles and achieve success in your life.
data.etymology: Faiyaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Triumphant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faiyaan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
